title: Fabric Not Durable
text: Fabric Not Durable. I like the look of this chair. However, the fabric is not durable at all. It came to me already torn because of how they package it in the box. Fortunately, those tears were covered when we assembled the chair. However, it does show how weak the fabric is when you pull at it. I doubt the seat will last long. All it is going to take is one bedazzled bottom or something in a pocket to rip it open. And for people who actually use their furniture, this isn’t going to work well. Assembly was pretty easy. It comes in 4 pieces. (Back and back legs, seat, and 2 front legs.)

product_metadata.title: Modway Baronet Modern Tufted Vegan Leather Upholstered Dining Chair in Black
features: CHIC DETAIL - Introduce sophistication with finely tufted buttons and a timeless look. Baronet is the perfect choice for hosting elegant dinners. Also popular in living rooms as an accent chair.

CONTEMPORARY STYLE - Boasting clean lines and a minimalist design, Baronet complements decor styles ranging from traditional to farmhouse and contemporary. Perfect for the modern dining or living room

SUPPORTIVE COMFORT - Expertly constructed with webbing and springs to prevent sagging, generously padded foam, Vegan Leather upholstery, and wood legs with non-marking caps. A premium seating experience.

SUPERIOR CONSTRUCTION - Instilling charm around the dining table, Baronet comes supported by solid wood legs with flared back legs that accentuate the progressive look. Perfect as a modern desk chair.
Note : To ensure proper assembly, please follow all steps provided in the installation manual (provided in pdf below)

CHAIR MEASUREMENTS - With a regal back and fine minimalist design, Baronet brings stylish splendor to your dining room. Chair Dimensions: 26.5"L x 21"W x 38.5"H; Maximum Weight Capacity: 286 lbs.Included Components: Assembly Manual
description: Bestow splendor with Baronet. Charm and elegance adorn this luxuriously button tufted dining chair complete with sleek curves and dignified form. Featuring dense foam padding, fine fabric upholstery, solid wood frame, and non-marking foot glides, Baronet is a stylish dining chair perfect for the modern home.
